pressure_note: Column headers in psia. Pressure in the saturation chamber read via port B on a Heise CM 32507 gauge (dead-weight accuracy within 1 psia); equilibrium pressures maintained within 1 psia of the reported gauge values, estimated accuracy within 2 psia. Whether total pressure (methane + water vapour) or methane partial pressure is not stated.
layout: wide: one row per solution/slurry, one CH4-molality column per pressure; one mapping per printed pressure column over the same CSV (key csv)
title_as_printed: Table 1. Measured and predicted 25 C CH4 solubilities in distilled water and in sea water of 34.84 permil salinity.

footnotes_as_printed.1: Precision and estimated error limits are within 0.0005 and 0.001 molal units, respectively.

value.what: methane molality (mol CH4 per kg water); header footnote 1 on 'Molal solubilities'

composition.other_species: Distilled water (rows 0-2); Sea water of 34.84 permil salinity (table title); matrix composition not given (natural sea water).

skip_rows.reason: 'Predicted' rows: model values from the O'Sullivan and Smith (1970) equation m = (chi P) exp(ln m* - V(P-1)/RT) with Din (1961) fugacity coefficients, m* from the Bunsen coefficients of Yamamoto et al. (1976), V = 35.5 cm3/mol; not measurements

conversion_needs: Sea-water row: salinity 34.84 permil; ionic composition of the sea water not given (builder needs a standard sea-water matrix if it wants molalities).
notes: Mapping for the 550 psia column. Measured rows are 1 and 4. The sea-water measured row (0.0263, 0.0400, 0.0514) equals the 'Seawater 34.84 o/oo' row of Stoessell and Byrne 1982b (GCA, extract/10.1016_0016-7037(82)90268-x, footnote ** 'Stoessell and Byrne (1982)'), i.e. this paper is the source of that row. The distilled-water measured row (0.0318, 0.0473, 0.0623) differs from the distilled-water row of 1982b (0.0319, 0.0483, 0.0617).
